heading: **4 February 2026**
body:
*New nucleosome preparations*

Nucleosome preparations for the following samples were collected:

1. ELFlig1  
2. ELF\_RF  
3. ELF\_FR

MNase test for these samples:

1 uL per sample \+ 0.25 uL rAlbumin \+ 5 uL MNase buffer (50 uL)

Incubate 37 C, 10 mins.

Loading order:

1. ELFlig1  
2. ELFlig1nuc  
3. ELF\_RFnuc  
4. ELF\_FRnuc  
5. ELFlig1nuc \+ MNase (2 wells)  
6. ELF\_RFnuc \+ MNase (2 wells)  
7. ELF\_FRnuc \+ MNase (2 wells)

Run on a 3% agarose gel and stain with SYBR green.

*Plasmid FIBER-Seq \- sample collection*

Harvest cells and wash once with cold 1X PBS. Remove all the buffer and freeze down the cell pellets.

*Biotin Buffer Plates*

Aliquot 25 uL per well to 12 plates (needs \~120 mL buffer).

*NCAP-SELEX & HT-SELEX programs*

I checked the programs Jussi shared with us (from Yimeng) \- these contain only HT-SELEX programs

*SBP-Octamer stock plate*

Total number of experiments using Octamer ⇒ (5 X lig200) \+( 5 X lig70N) \+ (1X lig147) \+ (1X lig40N) ⇒ We roughly use 1.8 uL per well (28 ng/uL) ⇒ For 12 plates this works out to be 8640 uL (241.92 ug)

33.4 uL Octamer stock (7.25 mg/mL) \+ 259.2 uL 100 mM TCEP \+ 8347.4 uL (Refolding Buffer \+ Glycerol)

Mix well and aliquot 720 uL per well along a single row of a deep storage plate and then aliquot to 90 uL per well of a 4titude 96-well plate. From here use the robot to aliquot to 22.5 uL per well of a 384-well 4titude plate for storage.

*Dried salt plates for reconstitution*

**sol1 Salt solution: 2M KCl\_1.491g KCl \+ 10mL TE \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 1mM TCEP**

50 mL

| KCl | 7.46 g |
| :---- | :---- |
| 100 mM TCEP | 0.5 mL |
| TE Buffer (100X) | 0.5 mL |
| EDTA-free protease inhibitor | 1 tablet |

Filter, mix well and aliquot into 5 uL per well of 384-well NUNC plates (12).

*Dilution Buffer Plates*

**Dilution buff: TE buffer \+ 1mM TCEP \+ cocktail Tablet \+ 2mM MgCl2**

500 mL

| TE Buffer (100X) | 5 mL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 100 mM TCEP | 5 mL |
| MgCl2 (1 M) | 1 mL |
| EDTA-free protease inhibitor | 10 tablets |

Mix the buffer and filter and store. Aliquot to 80 uL per well of 384-well Abgene storage plate (12 plates) ⇒ Needs about 390 mL of buffer.
